verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated SOC 2 product with automated tests, evidence collection, AI evidence review and continuous monitoring (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-34, vanta-docs-49). It ships pre-built frameworks with cross-mapped controls (vanta-docs-12), AI policy drafting (vanta-docs-15), and audit workflows with auditor collaboration and information request lists (vanta-docs-11, vanta-docs-29, vanta-docs-8). That covers the core of running a SOC 2 program in-platform. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of distinct Type I vs Type II workflows, explicit Trust Services Criteria control mapping, documented SOC 2 policy template library, independent or hands-on corroboration.
